![170 Key Performance Indicator (KPI) Examples & Templates](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081734-2633-0066-0000-e424d49497a5:4)
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are quantifiable metrics used to measure how effectively an organization or team achieves key business goals.[[1]](https://www.deel.com/blog/key-performance-indicators-examples/)

Here are top KPI examples organized by department and category:

### Top Universal Business KPIs

- **Revenue Growth Rate:** Tracks the percentage increase in sales over a specific time.[[1]](https://www.thoughtspot.com/data-trends/kpi/examples)[[2]](https://monday.com/blog/project-management/kpi/)
- **Net Profit Margin:** Measures the percentage of revenue left as profit after all expenses are paid.[[1]](https://www.thoughtspot.com/data-trends/kpi/examples)
- **Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT):** Gauges direct customer satisfaction with a product or service.[[1]](https://www.thoughtspot.com/data-trends/kpi/examples)
- **Net Promoter Score (NPS):** Measures customer loyalty and the likelihood of them recommending your business.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=awVbH2j7mV0)[[2]](https://www.deel.com/blog/key-performance-indicators-examples/)
- **Employee Retention Rate:** Tracks the percentage of staff who remain at the company over a period.[[1]](https://monday.com/blog/project-management/kpi/)

### KPI Examples by Department

- **Sales:** [Sales KPIs](https://www.qlik.com/us/kpi/kpi-examples) include monthly recurring revenue (MRR), customer acquisition cost (CAC), customer lifetime value (CLV), and pipeline conversion rate.[[1]](https://www.qlik.com/us/kpi/kpi-examples)[[2]](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/k/kpi.asp)
- **Marketing:** Track marketing qualified leads (MQLs), cost per lead (CPL), return on ad spend (ROAS), and website conversion rate.[[1]](https://www.spiderstrategies.com/kpi/)[[2]](https://www.qlik.com/us/kpi/kpi-examples)[[3]](https://explitia.com/blog/what-is-a-kpi-meaning-examles-and-use-examples/)
- **Customer Service:** Monitor average response time, first-contact resolution rate, and customer churn rate.[[1]](https://www.qlik.com/us/kpi)[[2]](https://www.spiderstrategies.com/kpi/)[[3]](https://www.deel.com/blog/key-performance-indicators-examples/)
- **Human Resources:** Measure employee turnover rate, time-to-hire, and absenteeism rate.[[1]](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/k/kpi.asp)[[2]](https://www.deel.com/blog/key-performance-indicators-examples/)[[3]](https://business.adobe.com/blog/basics/kpi)
- **Operations & IT:** Track server downtime, DORA metrics (for engineering speed and stability), inventory turnover, and operating cash flow.[[1]](https://business.adobe.com/blog/basics/kpi)[[2]](https://www.qlik.com/us/kpi/kpi-examples)[[3]](https://www.spiderstrategies.com/kpi/)[[4]](https://www.deel.com/blog/key-performance-indicators-examples/)

### Leading vs. Lagging KPIs

- **Leading Indicators:** Predictive metrics that forecast future performance (e.g., number of sales calls made or inbound leads generated).
- **Lagging Indicators:** Historical metrics that reflect past outcomes (e.g., total quarterly revenue or profit margin).[[1]](https://onstrategyhq.com/resources/27-examples-of-key-performance-indicators/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ke34s3hs8gs&t=50)
